headline: Thyrocare Technologies: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31 Disclosure Filed
sum: Thyrocare Technologies has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(1)-(2), indicating a substantial acquisition trigger or open offer obligation, though bidder identity and offer terms remain undisclosed in publicly available sources as of 18 August 2026.
implication: Regulation 31 filing signals crossing of 25% threshold or formal open-offer commencement; transaction architecture and structuring details are gated pending full offer document publication and SEBI review.
detail: The disclosure was formally submitted to NSE on 18 August 2026 under SEBI's takeover regime. Regulation 31 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 mandates disclosure by the target company within two days of acquisition of shares triggering the threshold. No public details on bidder, offer price, shareholding, or transaction consideration are accessible at this stage.

framework.note: Target company must disclose within 2 days of threshold crossing; covers disclosure of acquirer identity, shares acquired, consideration, and offer terms
Substantial acquisition threshold (25% and above); open offer triggers at 25%
Related party transaction and disclosure norms if acquirer is connected party; delisting provisions if applicable
Stock exchange regulatory jurisdiction over takeovers and open offers
If bidder seeks delisting post-acquisition, separate process required; 90% holding threshold applies
FDI approval if bidder is foreign entity; Regulation 4A or Schedule 1 compliance
Disclosure obligations and trading blackout for insiders during offer period

conditions: Open offer announcement and offer document submission to SEBI (if triggered)
Stock exchange approval of offer terms
Minority shareholder acceptance (minimum thresholds per SEBI norms)
approvals: SEBI review of offer document (if open offer applicable)
CCI approval (if deal value/parties trigger merger threshold - ₹2,000 cr+ combination)
structure.novel: Timing and bidder structure unknown from public disclosures; awaiting offer document.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure by target upon crossing 25% or receipt of substantial acquisition notice
